citeinfo.title: Sediment-Hosted Stratabound Copper Assessment of the Neoproterozoic Roan Group, Central African Copperbelt, Katanga Basin, Democratic Republic of the Congo and Zambia

descript.abstract: The Esri shapefile CACB_open_pits is a spatial database that provides spatial and descriptive information for sediment-hosted copper open-pit mines of the Central African Copperbelt, Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Zambia.
descript.purpose: The spatial database was created for use in a geographic information system (GIS) as part of Scientific Investigations Series Report 2010-5090-T, which is part of the USGS assessment of undiscovered copper resources of the world. It provides locations of open-pit mines, in addition to descriptive information for use in a GIS and for estimating undiscovered mineral resource endowments.

idinfo.useconst: This spatial database is not meant to be used or displayed at any scale larger than 1:1,000,000 (for example, 1:500,000).

horizpa.horizpar: Locations are based on Google Earth satellite imagery.

procstep.procdesc: This shapefile was created by manually digitizing open pits seen on Google Earth satellite imagery. The file was saved as a KML file in Google Earth and then converted to a shapefile using the “Import data from KML” option from XTools Pro in ArcMap. The open pits are attributed with the name of the corresponding mine seen in Google Earth or corresponding deposit or prospect point. The approximate scale of digitization is 1:20,000. This file was created in January of 2010; dates of Google Earth imagery used for digitization can be found using Google Earth's Historical Imagery option.
